description: All fifteen source segment unions in their source order, relabelled a-o. One source row reflows into five columns and three rows; no answer classification is added. Graph vertices have subpixel markers under strokes.

authoritativeText.text: 70.$^{\bullet}$ 图29上画出的许多图形是一些线段的并集.其中哪些是简单折线？
81.$^{\bullet}$ 图29上画出的图形中，哪些是简单闭折线？
如果线段$A_1A_2,A_2A_3,\cdots,A_{n-1}A_n(n>2)$当中，按顺序相邻两段不在一条直线上，而不相邻两段没有交点，那么这些线段的并集叫做简单折线$A_1A_2\cdots A_n$．
**简单折线**$A_1A_2\cdots A_n(n>2)$和线段$A_nA_1$当中，如果相邻两段（按圆周排列顺序）不在一条直线上，而不相邻的两段没有公共点，那么$A_1A_2\cdots A_n$和$A_nA_1$的并集叫做简单闭折线．
**注** 以后我们提到折线时均指简单折线（闭折线或不闭折线）．

inventory.description: Source item 1, letter а -> a. Four-sided rectangle only; no diagonal or middle bar. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
Source item 2, letter б -> b. Sloping free arm to top-right, then a descending right vertical. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
Source item 3, letter в -> c. Upper bar, upper-right vertical, lower-left diagonal and bottom bar. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
Source item 4, letter г -> d. Top and middle horizontals joined by two distinct descending diagonals. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
Source item 5, letter д -> e. Left upper arm ends at the middle of a full right vertical. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
Source item 6, letter е -> f. Five-stroke staircase: top, left upper, middle, right lower, bottom. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
Source item 7, letter ж -> g. Lower rectangular loop and diagonal pendant meeting at upper-left. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
Source item 8, letter з -> h. Top bar, diagonal to middle-left, then lower-left vertical. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
Source item 9, letter и -> i. Outer rectangle and middle crossbar; two explicit mid-side junctions. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
Source item 10, letter к -> j. Upper rectangular loop and descending-left pendant from lower-right. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
Source item 11, letter л -> k. Four-sided wedge outline with sloping lower-right side; no crossbar. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
Source item 12, letter м -> l. Wedge outline plus middle crossbar AND upper diagonal to top-right. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
Source item 13, letter н -> m. Wedge outline and middle crossbar; NO upper diagonal. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
Source item 14, letter о -> n. Top bar, left upper vertical, middle bar, then lower-left diagonal. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
Source item 15, letter п -> o. Two full verticals joined at their midpoints, with four free ends. Vertex positions regularized; incidence/edge inventory unchanged.
